# Authority.Records Copilot Instructions

The canonical project guidance — build commands, architecture, conventions,
and the list of files to read first — lives in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at
the repository root. Treat that file as the single source of truth for both
GitHub Copilot and Claude Code so the two assistants stay aligned.

If you need to update repo-wide guidance, edit `CLAUDE.md` directly rather
than duplicating instructions here.
